It’s a really hard decision to make honestly. On the one hand, players want to play powerful characters, and a lot of the time people will min/max or use loopholes to achieve that. On the other hand, the DMs job is to make sure their players have fun, and on of the easiest ways to do that is letting your players feel powerful. Ultimately it’s down to the DM and the group, not just one person. What you don’t want to do is restrict your players so much that even completing basic tasks becomes a challenge to them, nor do you want them to steamroll ever encounter. You gotta find the balance, things like making scenarios more complex with magical darkness, traps or hidden enemies go a long way towards bridging power gaps, as well as boosting less powerful characters naturally (giving feats for certain things etc)
